model.title: Falun Gong and Victims of Forced Organ Harvesting Protection Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would impose sanctions against Chinese officials and entities involved in forced organ harvesting, particularly targeting practices affecting Falun Gong practitioners and other persecuted groups. It aims to hold accountable those responsible for these human rights abuses and restrict their access to the U.S. financial system and visa privileges.
